name: darkvision
lore:
# Darkvision (*Visio Tenebris*)

To shape the Weave into *Darkvision* is to invite a cooling fluidness behind the brow, as if one’s optic nerves were being bathed in glacial meltwater. It is a subtle, stretching sensation—a dilation not just of the pupil, but of the soul’s perception.

When the incantation takes hold, the caster’s eyes undergo a startling transformation, shimmering with a faint, violet opalescence before the pupils expand into twin pools of obsidian. To the recipient, the suffocating gloom of the lightless deep does not merely fade; it shatters. The world is reborn in a sharp, monochromatic tapestry of silver and charcoal, revealing every jagged stalactite with the clarity of a high-noon sun.

**The Legend of the Sightless Queen**
Loremasters attribute the spell’s origin to Queen Vylari, who reigned over a sunless kingdom. It is said she wept until her tears turned to mercury, coating her eyes and granting her the "Sight of the Still Void" so she might lead her people through the Great Collapse. Use this gift with reverence, traveler, for it turns the terrifying unknown into a mere landscape.
